title: 第1章 天降仙尸第2章 香火
slug: 小狐狸的仙教版修行百科
content_zh:
月色疏疏，往日的虫鸣鸟叫皆消失不见，只余山风穿林之声。
自从天上掉下来个发光物体后，附近的动物都跑了，可有一只却是例外，它浑身赤色，毛发随风晃动，耳尖绷得笔直，蓬松的大尾巴扫动着落叶。
‘好烦好烦好烦！森林这么大，为什么偏偏落到这里，砸坏狐的窝！’
小狐狸歪着脑袋，鼻头皱成一团，打了个短促的喷嚏，继续研究着眼前的物体。
有点像没尾巴的无毛大家伙，但是比它见过的都要大，身上裹着的软皮看起来也油光水滑的，肯定不缺吃的。狐狸转过头，舔了舔自己略显粗糙的毛，心里暗暗对比，又回正脑袋朝天上瞅。
夜晴无云，月色透亮，每一根枝桠都看得清楚，并没有什么大鸟的身影。
也不是大鸟的猎物，狐狸愈加疑惑，从喉间发出几声低嗥，见那物体还是没反应，便小心地向前走了几步，用鼻吻轻触物体。先是一股幽香，像是某种草叶的味道，接着是刺骨的寒冷，小狐狸猛地打个哆嗦，爪子略微用力，一下子又跳回原位。
‘这么冰，而且从那么高掉下来，没死也动不了。’狐狸舔了舔鼻头，做出定论。它围着尸体又转了两圈，慢慢靠近，试探性地朝衣角咬去。试了几次，这玩意都毫无反应，它的动作越发大胆。见牙尖始终都无法勾上，索性将嘴巴张到最大，将尸体的肢体整个咬住，身体略微后压，尝试将尸体拖离。
‘好重好重好重！’
狐狸努力蹬着爪子，嘴里也咬得更加用力。就在僵持不下时，它的耳朵动了动，听见细细碎碎的声音从嘴边传来，狐狸瞪大眼睛，看到无数裂痕自尸体上蔓延，接着便是布满视野的白光。
整具尸体都化作一股流光，冲进狐狸的身体，将它撞得向后仰去，滚成一个红色团子。
“嘤——”一道短促的鸣叫在林中扩散，一切又重回寂静。
……
赤狐蜷在地上，月色亮的晃眼，撒在毛茸茸的背上，它的眸子没有睁开，抱着尾巴沉沉的睡着，可总有一道声音在耳边晃悠，不高不低，不疾不徐。
“舒毛展尾，迎月而立……”
这种叫声狐狸从未听过，却天然带有一种亲切感，它下意识甩动两下身子，把尾巴从怀里抽出来。
“口衔月露，吐浊纳清……”
月色更浓，呈现出一种水流般的质感。那暖融融的光像极了小时候母亲腹下的毛，软乎乎裹着它，赤狐下意识地张开嘴，几缕银线就如乳汁般涌入喉中。暖意顺着四肢往下渗，连毛发缝里都透着舒服的麻。
转眼间，已是河倾月落，东方欲晓。
粉色的舌头不甘地伸出，企图钩住最后一缕月光，却只是徒劳的舔了几口空气，狭长的眸子瞪得滚圆，满是震惊。

‘狐刚刚把什么玩意吃肚子里了？’
“月者，太阴之精，积阴之寒气以为形。月华者，至清之炁也，可洗髓伐毛，启迪灵智，涤荡……”
‘又是什么玩意在狐耳边鸣叫！’
肚子暖洋洋的，身体也充满力量，可咂咂嘴，一点味都没有。声音就在耳边，可左顾右盼，连只蚊虫也无。狐狸歪着头，小小的脑袋装着大大的疑惑。
所幸狐狸最是聪明，面对这突如其来的难题，它选择了最熟悉的应对方式。狐狸打了个哈欠，蜷成一团，将所有疑惑裹进了睡意。
‘吃饱了就睡觉，心揪了晒太阳。’
content_en:
The moonlight is sparse, and the chirping of insects and birds of the past have disappeared, leaving only the sound of the mountain wind flowing through the forest.
Since a luminous object fell from the sky, all nearby animals ran away, but there was one exception. It was red all over, its hair was swaying in the wind, the tips of its ears were stretched straight, and its big fluffy tail swept the fallen leaves.
‘It’s so annoying, so annoying, so annoying! The forest is so big, why did it fall here and destroy the fox's nest! ’
The little fox tilted his head, wrinkled his nose, sneezed briefly, and continued to study the objects in front of him.
It looks a bit like a big hairless guy without a tail, but it is bigger than anything it has ever seen before. The soft skin wrapped on its body also looks smooth and smooth. There must be no shortage of food. The fox turned his head, licked his slightly rough fur, secretly compared it in his mind, and then straightened his head and looked up at the sky.
The night was clear and cloudless, and the moonlight was bright. Every branch could be seen clearly, and there was no sign of any big bird.
It was not the prey of a big bird. The fox became more and more confused and let out several low howls from his throat. Seeing that the object still did not respond, he carefully took a few steps forward and touched the object lightly with his nose. First there was a faint fragrance, like the smell of some kind of grass blades, and then there was the biting cold. The little fox shivered violently, exerted a little force on its paws, and suddenly jumped back to its original position.
‘It’s so ice, and if you fall from such a height, you won’t be able to move even if you don’t die. ’ The fox licked his nose and made a conclusion. It circled the body twice more, slowly approached, and bit tentatively towards the corner of the clothes. After trying it several times, there was no response from this thing, and its movements became more and more bold. Seeing that the tips of his teeth could not be hooked, he simply opened his mouth to the maximum, bit the entire limb of the corpse, pressed back slightly, and tried to drag the corpse away.
‘So heavy, so heavy, so heavy! ’
The fox kicked his paws hard and bit harder in his mouth. Just when it was deadlocked, its ears moved, and it heard a thin sound coming from its mouth. The fox's eyes widened, and he saw countless cracks spreading from the corpse, and then white light filled the field of vision.
The entire corpse turned into a stream of light and rushed into the fox's body, knocking it backwards and rolling into a red ball.
"嘤——" A short cry spread in the forest, and everything returned to silence.
…
The red fox was curled up on the ground, the moonlight shining brightly on its furry back. Its eyes were not opened, and it was sleeping deeply with its tail in its arms, but there was always a sound lingering in its ears, neither high nor low, neither fast nor slow.
"Show your hair and tail, stand up to the moon..."
The fox had never heard this kind of cry before, but it naturally had a sense of intimacy. It subconsciously swung its body twice and pulled its tail out of its arms.
"Hold the moon dew in your mouth, spit out the turbidity and receive the clear..."
The moonlight is thicker, giving it a water-like texture. The warm light was very much like the fur under the mother's belly when she was a child, wrapping it softly. The red fox subconsciously opened its mouth, and a few strands of silver poured into its throat like milk. Warmth seeped down his limbs, and even the hair was feeling numb.
In the blink of an eye, the river is over, the moon is setting, and dawn is about to dawn in the east.
The pink tongue stretched out unwillingly, trying to catch the last ray of moonlight, but only licked a few mouthfuls of air in vain. The narrow eyes were wide and full of shock.
‘What did the fox eat just now? ’
"The moon is the essence of Taiyin, which accumulates the cold air of Yin to form the shape. The moonlight is the pure Qi, which can wash the marrow and cut the hair, enlighten the spiritual wisdom, and cleanse..."
‘What’s that thing ringing in the fox’s ears again! ’
My belly is warm and my body is full of strength, but when I smack my lips, there is no taste at all. The sound was right next to my ears, but when I looked around, there wasn't even a mosquito. The fox tilted his head, his little head filled with confusion.
Fortunately, the fox is the smartest. Faced with this sudden problem, it chose the most familiar way to deal with it. The fox yawned, curled up into a ball, and wrapped all his doubts into sleep.
‘Go to bed when you’re full, and bask in the sun when your heart is broken. ’
